notes: Primary source: QSC official PLD Series spec sheet (q_amp_pld_specs.pdf, rev 09/19/16) plus the official PLD Series User Manual (TD-000368-00-A, q_amp_pld_usermanual.pdf) for exact rear-panel connector counts/labels, since the spec sheet's feature bullets alone were ambiguous ("four Input XLR" + "six NL-4 Output"). Confirmed rear panel per the manual: 4x female XLR inputs (labeled 1-4), 4x male XLR loop-through outputs (parallel with inputs, for daisy-chaining), 4x NL4 individual/parallel speaker outputs (labeled A/B/C/D), 2x NL4 dedicated bridged outputs (labeled X/Y, X=A+B bridge, Y=C+D bridge), 1x USB Type-B 4-pin (control/firmware via Amplifier Navigator, not a network port), and 1x locking IEC AC inlet (100-240VAC universal). No Ethernet/RJ45, RS-232, or network/Dante/CobraNet card was found anywhere in the manual or spec sheet - this model has no network control port. No grade fields apply: XLR analog audio, Speakon speaker outputs, USB used only as a PC control link (no data-rate spec given, so omitted per no-grade-when-unstated rule), and IEC power input are all ungraded connector types. Rack height is 2U (3.5" x 19" x 16", shared chassis with PLD4.3; PLD4.2 is 12" deep but same 2RU height). Weight: 22.0 lb (10.0 kg) net.

ports.name: Input 1
ports.note: Female XLR balanced/unbalanced line input, >10k ohm impedance, selectable +4/+14 dBu sensitivity

ports.name: Output 1 (Loop)
ports.note: Male XLR, wired in parallel with Input 1 for daisy-chaining to next amplifier's input

ports.name: NL4 X
ports.note: Dedicated bridged output for A+B Bridged mode

ports.name: NL4 Y
ports.note: Dedicated bridged output for C+D Bridged mode

ports.name: USB
ports.note: USB Type B, 4-pin; connects to PC/Mac running QSC Amplifier Navigator software for control, preset management, and firmware updates

ports.name: AC In
ports.note: Locking IEC power inlet, universal 100-240 VAC 50-60 Hz switchmode supply; ships with a locking IEC cable
